name: fasta_validation/reported_member_organisms

name: fasta_validation/reported_leading_id

name: fasta_validation/reported_leading_accession

name: fasta_validation/reported_leading_description

name: fasta_validation/reported_leading_gene_name

name: rt_observed/-
basis: Observed precursor RT. AlphaDIA output-format documentation specifies seconds for precursor.rt.observed; the 1.12 raw-data wrapper constructs rt_values by multiplying AlphaRaw minute values by 60.

name: precursor_rt_observed/-
basis: Observed precursor RT. AlphaDIA output-format documentation specifies seconds for precursor.rt.observed; the 1.12 raw-data wrapper constructs rt_values by multiplying AlphaRaw minute values by 60.

name: rt_calibrated/-
basis: precursor.rt.calibrated is the library RT calibrated into the run: where AlphaDIA expects the precursor, on the run's seconds axis; it differs from rt_observed by tens of seconds.

name: precursor_rt_calibrated/-
basis: precursor.rt.calibrated is the library RT calibrated into the run: where AlphaDIA expects the precursor, on the run's seconds axis; it differs from precursor_rt_observed by tens of seconds.

name: rt_library/-
basis: The spectral library's RT; the library's own scale, which AlphaDIA calibrates into the run as rt_calibrated. A layer only because AlphaDIA writes it with run-to-run differences of up to 0.03.

name: precursor_rt_library/-
basis: The spectral library's RT; the library's own scale, which AlphaDIA calibrates into the run as precursor_rt_calibrated. A layer only because AlphaDIA writes it with run-to-run differences of up to 0.03.

name: cycle_fwhm/-
basis: cycle_fwhm, the peak width at half maximum counted in DIA cycles, not time; its duration depends on the cycle time.

name: precursor_rt_fwhm/-
basis: precursor.rt.fwhm, 3 for every precursor of a 2.1 submission like cycle_fwhm in 1.12: a count of DIA cycles rather than a time.

name: rt/-
basis: rt equals rt_apex, the apex of the feature's MS1 peak in the run. A uniform unit for every supported AlphaPept input route has not been established, so consumers must not assume one.

name: rt_start/-
basis: rt_start, where the feature's MS1 peak begins. A uniform unit for every supported AlphaPept input route has not been established, so consumers must not assume one.

name: rt_end/-
basis: rt_end, where the feature's MS1 peak ends. A uniform unit for every supported AlphaPept input route has not been established, so consumers must not assume one.

name: fwhm/-
basis: fwhm of the feature's MS1 peak, on the same axis as rt. A uniform unit for every supported AlphaPept input route has not been established, so consumers must not assume one.

name: rt_calib/-
basis: rt_calib, the apex after AlphaPept aligns the runs for matching between runs; it differs from rt by up to minutes. A uniform unit for every supported AlphaPept input route has not been established, so consumers must not assume one.

name: RT/-
basis: Observed precursor retention time in minutes, distinct from library iRT and Predicted.RT.

name: RT_Start/-
basis: RT.Start, where the precursor's elution peak begins, in minutes like RT.

name: RT_Stop/-
basis: RT.Stop, where the precursor's elution peak ends, in minutes like RT.

name: FWHM/-
basis: Estimated peak width at half maximum, in minutes: about 0.06 for RT around 16 in the 2.3 Astral submission.

name: FWHM/-
basis: Estimated peak width at half maximum, in minutes: about 0.06 for RT around 16 in the 2.3 Astral submission.

name: Predicted_RT/-
basis: Predicted.RT, the RT DIA-NN predicts in this run from the library iRT, in minutes.

name: Predicted_iRT/-
basis: Predicted.iRT, the observed RT mapped onto the library's iRT scale; it tracks iRT closely.

name: -/iRT
basis: iRT, the reference RT recorded in the spectral library, the same in every run.

name: Apex_Retention_Time/-
basis: FragPipe output reference defines Apex Retention Time as the retention time of the precursor apex intensity. FragPipe documents the unit as usually seconds but instrument-dependent, so the rule alone does not establish it.

name: Retention_Time_Start/-
basis: Where the precursor's elution peak begins in the sample. FragPipe documents the unit as usually seconds but instrument-dependent, so the rule alone does not establish it.

name: Retention_Time_End/-
basis: Where the precursor's elution peak ends in the sample. FragPipe documents the unit as usually seconds but instrument-dependent, so the rule alone does not establish it.

name: Retention_Time_FWHM/-
basis: Width of the precursor's elution peak at half maximum in the sample. FragPipe documents the unit as usually seconds but instrument-dependent, so the rule alone does not establish it.

name: Retention_time/-
basis: Evidence Retention time is the uncalibrated retention time in minutes.

name: Calibrated_retention_time/-
basis: Evidence Calibrated retention time is the retention time in minutes after MaxQuant aligns the runs for matching between runs.

name: Calibrated_retention_time_start/-
basis: Evidence Calibrated retention time start, where the elution peak begins on the calibrated time scale, in minutes.

name: Calibrated_retention_time_finish/-
basis: Evidence Calibrated retention time finish, where the elution peak ends on the calibrated time scale, in minutes.

name: Retention_length/-
basis: Evidence Retention length, the total width of the elution peak in minutes.

name: -/Retention_time
basis: Modification-specific peptide Retention time is in minutes, averaged over its evidence entries; this is a feature annotation, not a per-run RT measurement.

name: -/Calibrated_retention_time
basis: Modification-specific peptide Calibrated retention time, the calibrated RT in minutes averaged over its evidence entries; a feature annotation.

name: MS2_Retention_Time/-
basis: FlashLFQ's MS2 Retention Time, the scan time of the identifying MS/MS spectrum, in minutes: the committed sample spans 35-131.

name: Peak_RT_Apex/-
basis: FlashLFQ's Peak RT Apex, the apex of the peptide's MS1 peak in the run, in minutes like MS2 Retention Time; - where no peak was found.

name: Peak_RT_Start/-
basis: FlashLFQ's Peak RT Start, where the MS1 peak begins, in minutes; - where no peak was found.

name: Peak_RT_End/-
basis: FlashLFQ's Peak RT End, where the MS1 peak ends, in minutes; - where no peak was found.

name: elution_time/-
basis: Proline's per-run elution_time of the quantified peptide ion. The ProteoBench DDA submission spans 17-135, the range MaxQuant reports in minutes for the same raw files.

name: corrected_time/-
basis: Proline's per-run corrected_time, the elution time after map alignment: the runs' values agree within seconds where elution_time differs by minutes.

name: -/master_quant_peptide_ion_elution_time
basis: master_quant_peptide_ion_elution_time, one value per ion within seconds of the median per-run corrected_time.

name: -/master_elution_time
basis: master_elution_time, one value per ion: within 0.3 min of the earliest run's elution_time and up to minutes from master_quant_peptide_ion_elution_time. Proline does not document which time it is; read as a measured RT.

name: RT_mean/-
basis: The per-sample RT mean of the feature, in minutes: the ProteoBench DDA submission spans the range MaxQuant reports in minutes for the same raw files.

name: -/RT_mean
basis: The feature's RT mean across samples, in minutes like the per-sample values; a feature annotation.

name: elution_time/-
basis: Proline's per-run elution_time of the quantified peptide ion. The ProteoBench DDA submission spans 17-135, the range MaxQuant reports in minutes for the same raw files.

name: corrected_time/-
basis: Proline's per-run corrected_time, the elution time after map alignment: the runs' values agree within seconds where elution_time differs by minutes.

name: -/master_quant_peptide_ion_elution_time
basis: master_quant_peptide_ion_elution_time, one value per ion within seconds of the median per-run corrected_time.

name: -/master_elution_time
basis: master_elution_time, one value per ion: within 0.3 min of the earliest run's elution_time and up to minutes from master_quant_peptide_ion_elution_time. Proline does not document which time it is; read as a measured RT.

name: EG_ApexRT/-
basis: EG.ApexRT, the apex of the precursor's elution peak in the run. Spectronaut reports EG retention times in minutes: EG.ApexRT lies around 14 in a ProteoBench 15-minute Astral submission and reaches 249 in a 240-minute run.

name: EG_StartRT/-
basis: EG.StartRT, where the elution peak begins; it precedes EG.ApexRT in all but 0.01% of rows. Spectronaut reports EG retention times in minutes: EG.ApexRT lies around 14 in a ProteoBench 15-minute Astral submission and reaches 249 in a 240-minute run.

name: EG_EndRT/-
basis: EG.EndRT, where the elution peak ends; it follows EG.ApexRT. Spectronaut reports EG retention times in minutes: EG.ApexRT lies around 14 in a ProteoBench 15-minute Astral submission and reaches 249 in a 240-minute run.

name: EG_FWHM/-
basis: EG.FWHM, the peak width at half maximum on the RT axis; EG.FWHM (iRT) is the iRT-scale twin. Spectronaut reports EG retention times in minutes: EG.ApexRT lies around 14 in a ProteoBench 15-minute Astral submission and reaches 249 in a 240-minute run.

name: EG_PeakWidth/-
basis: EG.PeakWidth, the full width of the elution peak, wider than EG.FWHM. Spectronaut reports EG retention times in minutes: EG.ApexRT lies around 14 in a ProteoBench 15-minute Astral submission and reaches 249 in a 240-minute run.

name: EG_RTPredicted/-
basis: EG.RTPredicted, the library iRT calibrated into the run: where Spectronaut expects the precursor. Spectronaut reports EG retention times in minutes: EG.ApexRT lies around 14 in a ProteoBench 15-minute Astral submission and reaches 249 in a 240-minute run.

name: EG_iRTEmpirical/-
basis: EG.iRTEmpirical, the observed apex converted to the iRT scale; it tracks EG.iRTPredicted.

name: EG_StartiRT/-
basis: EG.StartiRT, the peak start on the iRT scale. It brackets EG.iRTEmpirical in only a quarter of the rows of a 240-minute report, so its relation to the apex is not established.

name: EG_EndiRT/-
basis: EG.EndiRT, the peak end on the iRT scale; see EG_StartiRT for the open question.

name: EG_FWHM_iRT/-
basis: EG.FWHM (iRT), the width at half maximum on the iRT scale.

name: EG_MeanApexRT/-
basis: EG.MeanApexRT differs between runs for one precursor and equals EG.ApexRT in most rows, so it is not an experiment-wide mean; what it averages over is not documented. Spectronaut reports EG retention times in minutes: EG.ApexRT lies around 14 in a ProteoBench 15-minute Astral submission and reaches 249 in a 240-minute run.

name: -/EG_iRTPredicted
basis: EG.iRTPredicted, the library iRT of the precursor, the same in every run.
